title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-02-15
source: MR > D Latvala Reels @ 3 3/4 ips > DBX Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > DAT > CD

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a stellar 1973 performance highlighted by an epic Dark Star→Eyes→China Doll suite and soaring Row Jimmy.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that, despite occasional balance quirks and slight speed variances, delivers clear vocals and generally crisp instrumentation. Musically the show shines—fans repeatedly point to the monumental Dark Star > Eyes of the World > China Cat Sunflower/I Know You Rider sequence, plus standout Row Jimmy, Playing in the Band and Here Comes Sunshine. Overall the performance is regarded as one of the year’s finest, with only minor set‑list dips noted.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (5‑star) praise the musical performance as exceptional while noting mostly good to excellent soundboard quality; a few mixed comments lower the recording rating slightly, yielding an overall high score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocal mix and generally crisp instruments; some reviewers note uneven instrument balance, occasional hiss, speed/varispeed artifacts, and a few drop‑outs, but the tape remains listenable.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Eyes of the World > China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A strong first set builds into a powerhouse second set, with an especially epic Dark Star/Eyes/China Cat Sunflower suite that anchors the show; pacing is slightly slower than usual but adds a relaxed, jam‑focused vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his “lazy” vocal style, country‑tinged phrasing, gritty down‑and‑dirty guitar tone and soaring solos throughout especially in Dark Star and Row Jimmy.
band_member_comments.Phil: His bass presence (“the Phil zone”) is described as unmistakable with a long, celebrated solo during the second set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano work called “great” and “perfect accompaniment,” adding inventive leads to China Cat Sunflower and solid support throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann receives high marks for perfectly tuned toms, crisp cymbal bell accents and overall superb drumming on tracks like Tennessee Jed and Row Jimmy.
